graham.brief:
Who is Chicago with Keenum under center? Case Keenum is in line to start at quarterback for Chicago with Caleb Williams out with a hamstring injury. This is Keenum's first start of the year. Williams started week 2 and played 86% of the snaps. Philadelphia is favored by 3.5, and the books look for about 22.5 points from them. The Chicago averages were built without Keenum.

Chicago's pass defense gives up yards through the air, 9th-worst in the league. Chicago is the 9th-most run-first offense in football, running more than the situation calls for. Just two games of snaps.

Chicago gets clean runs before contact, and Philadelphia keeps playing light in the box. D'Andre Swift is the primary back who's played 62% of the snaps.

The total has slipped from 44 to 41.5 during the week. Hurts' attempts line opened 29.5 and is 28.5 now. Bovada, Caesars and DraftKings moved Hurts' line first. Underdog hasn't moved Hurts yet.

What I can't tell yet is how much of the Chicago playbook Keenum gets. If Chicago runs over the first two series at the season rate the plan held, and a throwing start means the matchup moved it.
